facts.fact: MISA says sections 74 to 78 of the Act, in effect from 14 January 2025, restrict transfers abroad unless the recipient is adequate or safeguards apply.

MISA says transfers may go on an adequacy decision, safeguards such as standard clauses, or derogations including explicit consent, though a copy must be kept in Botswana and contract-based safeguards need the Commission's authorisation.
